comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Non-traded REIT earning rent from owning healthcare properties, not a fee-earning external manager of real estate companies.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Office REIT earning rental income from owned buildings; RMR earns management fees instead, so the business model differs.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Alternative asset manager earning management and advisory fees on managed capital, similar to RMR's fee-based private capital management.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Title insurer earning premiums and escrow fees from transactions, not an asset or property manager earning management fees.
